english.note: Use this colloquial expression especially when you estimated a quantity or number too high.

exampleSentences.english: I overestimate the number of people when buying groceries, so I buy too much food.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我買餸嗰陣估多咗人數，買咗太多菜。
